routes.citation: Uriguen, J. A., Garcia-Zapirain, B., Artieda, J., Iriarte, J., and Valencia, M. (2017). Comparison of background EEG activity of different groups of patients with idiopathic epilepsy using Shannon spectral entropy and cluster-based permutation statistical testing. PLOS ONE 12(9), e0184044.
routes.bounded_read: The complete open-access article was read end to end, including front matter, abstract, introduction, methods, results, discussion, conclusions, data availability, funding, references, tables, and figure captions. Equation 1 defines Shannon spectral entropy from a unit-sum power spectrum and defines zero-power contributions as zero; the method section explains the high-flat-spectrum versus low-concentrated-spectrum interpretation.
routes.claim_boundary: Supports spectral entropy as a deterministic frequency-domain irregularity descriptor. It does not establish a WTI trading edge, a periodogram convention, a 48-return window, a 0.88 gate, monthly continuation, CFD equivalence, activity, profitability, or portfolio fit. Its EEG thresholds and results do not transfer.

routes.bounded_read: The complete periodogram function and documentation plus the relevant _spectral_helper detrending, real-FFT, power, scaling, and one-sided branch were read. The default removes a constant, uses a real one-sided transform, doubles paired positive-frequency powers, and does not double the even-length Nyquist bin.
routes.claim_boundary: Pins the transparent periodogram convention only. The EA independently evaluates the locked 48-point DFT and does not import or execute Python, SciPy, FFT libraries, or third-party code at runtime.
